Word vectors from a pretrained file or trained with word2vec, GloVe or fastText.

Reads GloVe / fastText / word2vec vectors (.txt, .vec, .bin) and fastText models (.bin), or trains word2vec (skip-gram or CBOW), GloVe or fastText (word2vec with character n-grams) on a text column on the selected device, lines them up with a vocabulary (the Text Tokenizer's vocabulary file; with fastText, tokens without a vector are built from their n-grams) and saves them for an Embedding layer to load. Optionally adds each row's mean word vector as columns.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Text](../categories/text.md) |

| Also read from graphs as | `WordEmbeddings` |

| Settings | In its own window (double-click the node) |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Text** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Table with the text column (for training and row vectors) |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Vectors** | Dataset | No | 1 | word, v_0 .. v_{d-1}: one row per vocabulary token, in token-id order (also saved; an Embedding layer loads the file) |
| **Rows** | Dataset | No | 1 | The input plus emb_0 .. emb_{d-1}, each row's mean word vector (with Row vectors on) |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Source | Source | `source` | Choice | `pretrained` | `pretrained`, `word2vec`, `glove`, `fasttext` | The run | Pretrained vector file, or train word2vec, GloVe or fastText on the text column. |
| Source | Vector file | `vectors_file` | File | (empty) | `*.txt;*.vec;*.bin` | The run | Pretrained vectors: GloVe .txt, fastText / word2vec .vec, word2vec .bin, fastText model .bin. |
| Source | Read at most | `max_words` | Integer | `0` |   | The run | Read at most this many words of the file (0: all) |
| Source | Text column | `text_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Text column to train on and to average for row vectors. |
| Vocabulary | Vocabulary file | `vocab_file` | File | (empty) | `*.txt` | The run | Vocabulary to line the vectors up with (the Text Tokenizer's vocabulary file); empty keeps the vectors' own words. |
| Vocabulary | Match lowercase | `lowercase_fallback` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Look a token up in lowercase when it is not found as written. |
| Vocabulary | Missing words | `missing` | Choice | `zeros` | `zeros`, `random` | The run | Rows of tokens without a vector: zeros, or random at the vectors' spread. |
| Vocabulary | Unknown token | `unknown` | Choice | `mean` | `mean`, `missing` | The run | The unknown token's row: the mean vector, or as a missing word. |
| Vocabulary | Random seed | `seed` | Integer | `0` |   | The run | Seed of the random rows of missing words. |
| Vocabulary | Words not trained | `unseen_words` | Choice | `pieces` | `pieces`, `missing` | The run | fastText: tokens without a vector (with a letter or digit) built from their character n-grams, or treated as missing words. |
| word2vec | Model | `architecture` | Choice | `skipgram` | `skipgram`, `cbow` | The run | word2vec and fastText model: skip-gram predicts the context from a word, CBOW a word from its context. |
| Training | Vector size | `vector_size` | Integer | `100` |   | The run | Values per word vector (word2vec, GloVe and fastText) |
| word2vec | Window | `window` | Integer | `5` |   | The run | Largest distance between a word and its context. |
| Training | Minimum count | `min_count` | Integer | `5` |   | The run | Words seen fewer times are left out (word2vec, GloVe and fastText) |
| word2vec | Negative samples | `negative` | Integer | `5` |   | The run | Noise words per example (negative sampling) |
| word2vec | Epochs | `epochs` | Integer | `5` |   | The run | Passes over the text. |
| word2vec | Down-sampling | `sample` | Number | `1e-3` |   | The run | Down-sampling threshold for frequent words (0: off) Advanced. |
| word2vec | Learning rate | `alpha` | Number | `0.025` |   | The run | Starting learning rate. Advanced. |
| word2vec | Final learning rate | `min_alpha` | Number | `0.0001` |   | The run | Learning rate at the end. Advanced. |
| word2vec | Batch | `batch_size` | Integer | `2048` |   | The run | Examples per device step (word2vec and fastText) Advanced. |
| Training | Seed | `train_seed` | Integer | `1` |   | The run | Seed of the initial vectors and the sampling (word2vec, GloVe and fastText); the same seed repeats a run. |
| GloVe | Window | `glove_window` | Integer | `10` |   | The run | GloVe: largest distance between two counted words (a pair d apart counts 1/d) |
| GloVe | Epochs | `glove_epochs` | Integer | `25` |   | The run | GloVe: passes over the word pairs. |
| GloVe | Count cap | `x_max` | Number | `100` |   | The run | GloVe: pairs seen more often all weigh the same. Advanced. |
| GloVe | Weighting power | `weighting_power` | Number | `0.75` |   | The run | GloVe: weight of rarer pairs, (count / x_max) to this power. Advanced. |
| GloVe | Learning rate | `glove_learning_rate` | Number | `0.05` |   | The run | GloVe: AdaGrad learning rate. Advanced. |
| GloVe | Batch | `glove_batch` | Integer | `8192` |   | The run | GloVe: word pairs per device step. Advanced. |
| fastText | Pieces from | `min_n` | Integer | `3` |   | The run | fastText: shortest character n-gram of "&lt;word>". |
| fastText | Pieces to | `max_n` | Integer | `6` |   | The run | fastText: longest character n-gram. |
| fastText | Buckets | `bucket` | Integer | `2000000` |   | The run | fastText: rows the n-grams are hashed into (4 x vector size bytes each on the device) Advanced. |
| Outputs | Save vectors | `vectors_path` | File | (empty) | `*.vec` | The run | Where the vectors are saved (word2vec .vec text); empty saves them in the project's artifacts. |
| Outputs | Row vectors | `row_vectors` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Also output each row's mean word vector as columns emb_0 .. emb_{d-1} (Rows pin) |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
